Method of Attack: Mass distribution of ransomware through hacking MSPs to distribute ransomware to all MSP clients
Exploitation of a vulnerability in the ManagedITSync plugin integrating ConnectWise and Kaseya to gain access to MSP backend
Using compromised MSP backend to push ransomware to client endpoints
Impacted Systems: MSP client endpoints managed via ConnectWise and Kaseya
Attack Vector: Remote access to MSP backend systems
Indicators of Compromise: Infection of endpoints with GandCrab ransomware
Presence of vulnerable ManagedIT.asmx file on Kaseya server
Advisory and scanning tool released by ConnectWise
